Devghar jile ke devipur men karoron rupye ki lagat se bane navnirmit sains sentar ka uddeshy jile ke bachchon ko vigyan ke prati jagruk karna hai. sath hi kitabi gyan ke sath vaigyanik gatividhiyon se rubru karana bhi hai. lekin is bhavy sains sentar ke nirman ke bad ab jila shiksha vibhag ke samne ek naee chunauti khari ho gaee hai.
